data.long_meaning: The name Jeannette is derived from the French name Jeanne, which comes from the Hebrew name Johanna or Hanah, meaning 'God is gracious'. The name was popularized by Jeanne d'Arc, also known as Joan of Arc, who was a heroic French warrior and a mystic who claimed to have visions from God. She led the French army to several important victories during the Hundred Years' War, and was canonized as a saint in the Roman Catholic Church.
